Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The mass spectrometry experiment described in the text and PRIDE metadata is a discovery-based interactome study (AP-MS) to identify proteins interacting with RPA194. While the broader paper contains many perturbation experiments (siRNA, DNA damage, etc.), the MS analysis itself is a simple comparison between a specific antibody IP (RPA194) and a negative control (IgG) in a single cell line (HCT116). Therefore, it is classified as 'un-classified' as it is an interactome mapping rather than a differential perturbation study.
